Q: CSS Media Queries not triggering correctly inside an IFrame on Tablet devices ( IFrame Wix HTML Component) A:

The problem is media queries inside an iframe respond to the iframe's width, not the device screen so on tablets, Wix is probably rendering it at a width outside your 601–1024px range.

Try ditch media queries, use ResizeObserver instead:

const container = document.getElementById('container');

new ResizeObserver(([entry]) => {

const w = entry.contentRect.width;

container.classList.remove('tablet', 'desktop');

if (w >= 1025) container.classList.add('desktop');

else if (w >= 601) container.classList.add('tablet');

}).observe(container);

Then just replace your media query CSS with .tablet and .desktop class selectors.
